spans.s: ऋग्—अयन n. (not -अयण, Pat. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 3) going through the Veda, study of the complete Veda, a book treating on the study of the Veda, T.
ऋग्—अय˚नादि m. N. of a gaṇa, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 73.
ऋग्—आत्मक mfn. ‘consisting of Ṛcas’, Ṛc-like Comm. on Pāṇ. vii, 4, 38.
ऋग्—आवानम् ind.p. (√ वे), connecting one Ṛc with another not interrupting their continuance, ĀśvŚr.
ऋग्—गण m. pl. the whole body of the Ṛg-veda.
ऋग्—गाथा f. a song consisting of Ṛc-like stanzas, Yājñ. iii, 114.
